description: This file defines an abstract class 'LinkBase' for handling link display in Drupal views, including access control, URL generation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: LinkBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for link field handlers in Drupal views, including access checks, URL handling, and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies such as access manager, entity type manager, entity repository, and language manager.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the link, including display text.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for configuring the link, including display text.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the field uses SQL GROUP BY clause; returns FALSE.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Adds translation query if multilingual, and additional fields.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the link if access is granted, applying metadata.

methods.name: checkUrlAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for the link URL.

methods.name: getUrlInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve URL information for the link.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Prepares and returns the link text for rendering.

methods.name: addLangcode
methods.description: Adds language information to the link options based on entity translation.

methods.name: getDefaultLabel
methods.description: Provides default label 'link' for the URL.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Returns the entity type manager service.
